2027-01-18.title: Monday after the Second Sunday after Denho · First Day of the Fast of the Ninevites
readings: Jonah flees from the presence of the Lord
He humbled himself and became obedient
2027-01-18.alt: Season of Denho. Moonnu Nombu, the fast of the Ninevites (Baooutho d'Ninwoye). Commemoration of Moran Mor Cyril Baselios Catholicos (+2007), first Major Archbishop-Catholicos, and of Joseph Mar Severios (+1955): Hebrews 13:7–16; Matthew 24:45–51. Mar Cyril and Mar Athanasius of Alexandria. Church Unity Octave begins.
2027-01-18.verse: For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the sea monster, so for three days and three nights the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth.
theo: The fast of the Ninevites begins with a prophet running away. God sends Jonah to Nineveh, “But Jonah set out to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.” A storm rises; the pagan sailors pray while the prophet sleeps below deck. Jonah is like many of us: we know God's will and go the other way. The Three Days' Fast is our chance to stop running, to turn the ship around.

Paul shows the opposite of Jonah: Christ, “though he was in the form of God”, did not run from the Father's will but “humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.” In the Gospel Jesus names Jonah as his sign: three days in the sea monster, three days in the tomb, and then the rising. Today we also remember Moran Mor Cyril Baselios, who led our Church as its first Major Archbishop, and Joseph Mar Severios. Hebrews tells us: “Remember your leaders… consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.”
outline: Ask: have you ever known what God wanted and gone the other way?
The prophet asleep in the storm.
“Let the same mind be in you that was in Christ Jesus.”
live: Name one thing God is asking of you that you have been avoiding, and begin it today.
Fast as your health allows and give the saving to the poor.
2027-01-18.prayer: Lord Jesus, you obeyed the Father to the cross and rose on the third day, the true sign of Jonah. As we begin the fast of the Ninevites, turn us back from our flight, humble our hearts, and through the prayers of Moran Mor Cyril Baselios and Joseph Mar Severios keep our Church faithful. Amen.
altar: The Holy Qurbono makes present the One who went down into death and rose: the sign of Jonah given to us at the altar.

quick: Jonah fled from the presence of the Lord.
Christ humbled himself and obeyed to the cross.
Jesus is the sign of Jonah: three days, then the rising.
2027-01-18.action: Begin today one thing God asks of you that you have avoided.
2027-01-18.question: Where am I fleeing from God's will?

family.explain: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh, but Jonah ran away on a ship. A big storm came. We cannot hide from God!
family.intention: We pray for our bishops and for the souls of Moran Mor Cyril Baselios and Joseph Mar Severios.
family.ask: Ask: “What will each of us give up for the three days?”

illus: A young man from Thiruvalla, offered a job abroad, had promised his dying father he would look after his mother. He boarded the plane anyway, and for two years felt, in his words, like Jonah asleep in the storm. During Moonnu Nombu he came home for good. He said: the moment I turned the ship around, the storm in me stopped.

pm.open: Lord, as we begin the fast of the Ninevites, stop our running and turn us back to you. Amen.
share: Jonah set out to flee from the presence of the LORD (Jonah 1:3). Where am I running?
He humbled himself and became obedient (Philippians 2:8). What would obedience look like for me?
The sign of Jonah (Matthew 12:39). Do I believe in the Resurrection with my whole life?
pm.resp: Lord, turn us back to you.
interc: For our Church, as we keep the fast of the Ninevites.
For the soul of Moran Mor Cyril Baselios and of Joseph Mar Severios.
For those running from God's call.
For our group, that we may obey as Christ obeyed.
pm.close: Father, your Son humbled himself and rose on the third day. Give us his mind and his obedience. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, the fast of the Ninevites begins with a prophet running away. God says to Jonah: go to Nineveh. But Jonah set out to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD (Jonah 1:3). The storm rises, the pagan sailors pray, and the prophet sleeps.
We are often like Jonah. We know what God wants and we go the other way. These three days are our chance to stop running.

Paul shows us the opposite: Christ humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross (Philippians 2:8). And Jesus calls himself the sign of Jonah: three days in the heart of the earth, then the Resurrection (Matthew 12:40).

Today we remember Moran Mor Cyril Baselios and Joseph Mar Severios, shepherds of our Church. Remember your leaders, says Hebrews, and imitate their faith (Hebrews 13:7). Let us turn the ship around and walk with Christ. Amen.
kids: Children, Jonah ran away from God, but God did not give up on him! These three days, let us say sorry and come back to God.

intro: Theme: “Let the same mind be in you that was in Christ Jesus.”
Jonah runs; Christ obeys; the sign of Jonah is the Resurrection.

q: But Jonah set out to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid his fare and went on board, to go with them to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.
Let the same mind be in you that was in Christ Jesus,
points.apply: Stop avoiding one thing God asks of you.

q: Where can I go from your spirit? Or where can I flee from your presence?
he humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death— even death on a cross.
points.apply: Accept one humbling thing without complaint.

q: But the LORD provided a large fish to swallow up Jonah; and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the sea monster, so for three days and three nights the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth.
points.apply: Bring a dead area of your life to the risen Christ.

concl: The fast begins by stopping our flight.
The obedient Christ is our sign of hope.
2027-01-18.resolve: Keep the three days' fast with prayer and almsgiving.
